newsitem.title: USA: U.S. soyoil weekly export sales highlights - USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. soyoil weekly export sales highlights - USDA.

text.p: USDA soyoil weekly export sales highlights in latest reporting week:

Net sales of 4,300 MT were primarily the result of increases for Hong Kong (9,400 MT, includes 3,000 new sales and 6,400 destination changes), South Korea (7,000 MT), and China (5,600 MT) being partially offset by reductions of 19,000 MT for unknown destinations.
Exports of 56,300 MT--a marketing-year high--were mainly to China (42,600 MT), Hong Kong (11,400 MT), and Haiti (1,800 MT).
